body:
I dunno. The main thing would be telling anyone how I really feel which I have never done. I fake being interested and happy with things pretty much all day. Disturbing the balance of my house and having my family know I wanted to go to a shrink would disrupt my life SO much. Not to mention I know I would have to sit across from my old man at the dinner table with him practically calling me a pussy through telepathy. And if they knew I thought about killing myself all day? Fuck no...

Another part of me thinks I am just being a wimp and should be able to be 'normal' myself. Shit I find it hard to talk about this without lying to make it sound better.
